skills.summary: Reproduce, isolate, prove, fix the root cause
skills.job: Debug by reproducing, isolating, forming hypotheses, proving one, then fixing the root cause
triggers: this keeps failing and I do not know why
find the root cause of this bug
gotchas: fixing the symptom where it surfaces instead of where the bad value is born
changing several things at once so no change is proven
declaring done without rerunning the original repro

skills.summary: Red, green, refactor in small steps
skills.job: Drive a change with a failing test first, the smallest code to pass, then a refactor
triggers: write the failing test then implement
gotchas: a test that passes before the code exists proves nothing
writing the whole feature after one big test
refactoring while the suite is red

skills.summary: Test a local web app with the browser tools
skills.job: Drive a locally running web app through the browser tools, check behaviour, console and layout
triggers: test my web app in the browser
click through the app and check it works
check the console errors on my local site
gotchas: asserting before the page has settled
testing a stale dev server build
trusting a screenshot without reading page text or console

skills.summary: Find why a test passes sometimes and fix it
skills.job: Find the cause of an intermittent test and remove it instead of retrying
gotchas: adding retries or sleeps that hide the cause
blaming CI when the test depends on order or shared state
one green run taken as proof of a fix

skills.summary: Find untested behaviour that matters
skills.job: Read coverage output and code to list the untested behaviour worth testing, ranked by risk
gotchas: chasing the percentage instead of risky branches
counting lines executed as lines verified
listing getters and glue code as gaps

skills.summary: Write tests from properties, not examples
skills.job: Pick invariants for a function and write generator based tests that find edge cases
triggers: fuzz this function with random inputs
gotchas: a property that restates the implementation
generators that never reach the edge cases
ignoring the shrunk counterexample and loosening the property

skills.summary: Review snapshot diffs before accepting them
skills.job: Decide whether a changed snapshot is an intended change or a regression before updating it
gotchas: updating all snapshots to get green
snapshots containing timestamps or ids that change each run
huge snapshots nobody reads

skills.summary: Find the commit that broke something
skills.job: Use git bisect with a scripted check to find the first bad commit
gotchas: a check that fails for a different reason on old commits
dirty working tree or stale build cache skewing results
forgetting to run git bisect reset

skills.summary: Find the signal in a large log
skills.job: Reduce a large log to the first failure, its context and a short timeline
triggers: what went wrong in these logs
find the error in this output
gotchas: reading the last error instead of the first
missing time zone or clock skew between sources
treating repeated noise lines as the cause

skills.summary: Read a crash report or stack trace
skills.job: Read a stack trace or crash report top to bottom and point at the frame that matters
triggers: what does this stack trace mean
my app crashed with this report
gotchas: stopping at the top frame which is often library code
source maps or symbols missing so lines are wrong
trusting line numbers from a different build

skills.summary: Find what keeps memory growing
skills.job: Confirm a leak with measurements, find the retaining reference and fix it
triggers: process runs out of memory after a while
gotchas: mistaking cache growth or GC lag for a leak
measuring once instead of over repeated cycles
fixing the allocation site instead of the retaining reference

skills.summary: Track down timing and concurrency bugs
skills.job: Find the unsynchronised shared state or ordering assumption behind a timing dependent bug
triggers: it only fails sometimes under load
I think there is a race condition
async code runs in the wrong order
gotchas: adding a delay that only moves the window
assuming single threaded means no races across awaits
logging that changes the timing and hides the bug

skills.summary: Choose fakes, stubs and mocks well
skills.job: Decide what to fake in a test, at which boundary, and write fakes that do not drift from the real thing
triggers: my tests are full of mocks
gotchas: mocking the unit under test
mocks that return shapes the real service never does
asserting call counts instead of outcomes

skills.summary: Set up tests that touch real components
skills.job: Set up isolated integration tests with real dependencies, seeded data and cleanup
gotchas: tests sharing one database state
pointing tests at a real dev or production service
setup so slow nobody runs the suite

skills.summary: Plan end to end tests for key user flows
skills.job: Choose the few user flows worth an end to end test and write each as steps with checks
triggers: what should my e2e tests cover
write a test plan for this app
gotchas: automating every path instead of the critical few
selectors tied to styling classes
tests that depend on data left by other tests

skills.summary: Build clear, minimal test data
skills.job: Create builders or fixtures that make test data short, valid and explicit about what matters
gotchas: one giant shared fixture every test mutates
defaults that are invalid so each test patches them
random data without a printed seed

skills.summary: Turn an error message into a fix
skills.job: Explain an error message in plain words, find its true source and give the smallest fix
triggers: I get this error when I run it
gotchas: fixing the last line when the first error caused the rest
searching the message without the tool and version
pasting a fix that silences the error without addressing it

skills.summary: Shrink a failing case to its smallest form
skills.job: Cut a failing program, input or config down to the smallest version that still fails
triggers: I need a small repro for this bug
narrow down which input breaks it
gotchas: removing a part that changes the failure into another one
stopping when it is small but still has unrelated code
not rechecking the repro in a clean directory

skills.summary: Sort a red test run into causes
skills.job: Group failing tests by shared cause and decide whether the test, the code or the environment is wrong
triggers: a lot of tests are failing
the suite went red after my change
gotchas: fixing failures one by one when one cause explains many
editing the test to match wrong behaviour
not checking whether the failure exists on the base branch

skills.summary: Check that tests catch real bugs
skills.job: Break the code on purpose in small ways and see whether the tests notice
triggers: do my tests actually catch bugs
try breaking my code to test the tests
gotchas: leaving a mutation in the source afterwards
counting equivalent mutants as test failures
mutating code with no tests on purpose
